title: BuCor checking records before release of Cedric Lee, Deniece Cornejo
summary: The Bureau of Corrections (BuCor) said Monday it was verifying the court records of Cedric Lee and Deniece Cornejo before carrying out their release, despite an order from the Court of Appeals…

blocks.text: The Bureau of Corrections (BuCor) said Monday it was verifying the court records of Cedric Lee and Deniece Cornejo before carrying out their release, despite an order from the Court of Appeals directing that they be freed.
